en.html: Armor racing begins some thirty years ago, in the British Commonwealth. Like horse racing and several motor sports, it starts with the nobles of the Queen's country finding something to do with themselves. Before this, every country regards tsurugi as sacred. Outside a war deciding the nation's fate, using one is unthinkable. Then the new, mass-produced models arrive, and suddenly the unthinkable is open for discussion. Race the fastest beings in the world: warriors. The idea receives thunderous applause. The gentlemen cannot understand why such a magnificent sport was not thought of earlier. A sacred instrument of war has become an excellent way to spend an afternoon. With full enthusiasm, they organize the thing. Thus, armor racing. From the British mainland it takes one year to cross the Dover Strait—rather slow for a speed event—and about three more to spread throughout Europe and acquire a unified governing body. Yamato joins in some twenty years ago. Immediate fanatical support, excellent prospects. Then the world goes into the Great War, and many enterprises not serving the military are forcibly reduced. Armor racing also receives its instruction to restrain itself. During the war it is, in effect, wiped out. Afterward the calls for its revival grow, some powerful people agree, and the organization is rebuilt... At the beginning of last year, Kamakura Circuit is completed. This year, Koryu 41, finally comes the decision: a Yamato Grand Prix, under one national standard. The first event is now—◆ under way.

Before this, every country regards tsurugi as sacred. Outside a war deciding the nation's fate, using one is unthinkable. Then the new, mass-produced models arrive, and suddenly the unthinkable is open for discussion.

Race the fastest beings in the world: warriors. The idea receives thunderous applause. The gentlemen cannot understand why such a magnificent sport was not thought of earlier. A sacred instrument of war has become an excellent way to spend an afternoon. With full enthusiasm, they organize the thing.

Thus, armor racing. From the British mainland it takes one year to cross the Dover Strait—rather slow for a speed event—and about three more to spread throughout Europe and acquire a unified governing body.

Yamato joins in some twenty years ago. Immediate fanatical support, excellent prospects. Then the world goes into the Great War, and many enterprises not serving the military are forcibly reduced.

Armor racing also receives its instruction to restrain itself. During the war it is, in effect, wiped out. Afterward the calls for its revival grow, some powerful people agree, and the organization is rebuilt...

At the beginning of last year, Kamakura Circuit is completed. This year, Koryu 41, finally comes the decision: a Yamato Grand Prix, under one national standard.

The first event is now—◆

under way.

ja.text:
装甲競技アーマーレースの端緒は現在からおよそ三十年前まで遡る。
　発祥は大英連邦ブリテン。競馬や幾つかのモータースポーツ
がそうであるように、この競技もまた女王の国の貴族
たちの遊戯から始まった。

　かつては何処の国にあっても劔冑は神聖性を帯びて
見られ、国家の帰趨を占う戦争以外の場で用いるなど
論外であった。
　が、新式（量産型）劔冑の誕生がその観念を変える。

　この世で最も速い存在である武者による競走という
発想は大喝采をもって迎えられ、紳士たちはどうして
こんな素晴らしい競技をもっと早く考え付かなかった
のだろうと首を傾げつつ、情熱に従って形式を整えた。

　装甲競技はかくして誕生する。
　英国本土を原点に、ドーバー海峡を越えるまで一年、
欧州全土へ普及して統合団体が結成されたのはその約
三年後。

　大和における歴史は二十年ほど前に幕を開け、忽ち
熱狂的な支持を受けて大いに隆盛する兆しを見せたが、
折しも世界は戦雲の最中。大戦への突入と共に軍事へ
寄与しない事業の多くは強制縮小の憂き目に遭う。

　装甲競技もその例から漏れず、戦時中は自粛を余儀
なくされ、事実上潰滅の状態にあった。
　終戦後、時が経過すると共に復興を望む声は高まり、
権力層の中にも同調する者があって、団体が再興……

　昨年初頭にはこの鎌倉サーキット場が落成。
　今年――興隆四一年に至って遂に、国内統一規格の
大和ＧＰ開催が決定した。

　その第一回が、今……◆
　
　始まっていた。

en.html:
I loosen my collar as I answer Ichijou. She is stretching up from her seat, looking around. The heat here is considerable. The crowd and its excitement have dismissed the autumn wind and called summer back to duty.

None of the riders on the course is regarded as first-rate. Those appear tomorrow or later. Still, this much excitement already.

So badly people wanted armor racing back. Until yesterday, the best available was little more than an amateur race wearing a respectable mustache. The frustration with that arrangement is now very easy to understand.

For these fans, sport has come close to religion. To a person without interest, something appears medically wrong. But the faces cheering the riders show nothing unhealthy. Only joy, plain and complete.

客席から伸び上がるようにして辺りを見回す一条の
声に応じつつ、襟元を軽くくつろげる。
　会場の熱気は相当なものだった。群れをなす人々、
そしてその興奮が、秋風を払って夏を呼び戻している。

　今、コース上を疾走する騎影の中に一流と目される
選手の姿はない。彼らの登場は明日以降になる。
　にも拘わらずこの盛況。

　装甲競技の復興がいかに望まれていたか、草レース
に毛を生やした程度の大会しか催されない昨日までの
状況がどれほど不満を集めていたか。
　手に取るような確かさで窺い知れた。

　この種の競技の愛好者が有する熱意は信仰にも近い
ものがある。関心のない人間には異常と映るほど。
　しかし、選手へエールを送る人々の表情に不健全な
何かはなかった。純粋な歓喜だけがあった。

Kageaki"Excited, yes. But everyone is sane. No sign of mental contamination. Besides, Silver Star is a masterpiece tsurugi. Hiding at a circuit would be difficult."
Ichijou"Why?"
Kanae"Arre, Ichijou. First time at a circuit?"
Ichijou"Hm? Haan. Never had much interest. Looks pretty good now I'm seeing it, though."
Kanae"Racing uses the new, mass-produced tsurugi. A masterpiece on the circuit is something you will hardly ever see."
Kanae"It cannot win."
Ichijou"Kyun? Masterpiece is better than mass-produced, na?"
Kanae"For combat, yes. Unfortunately, the trophy is not awarded for killing the other participants. This is a contest of speed."
Kanae"Modern tsurugi have a dedicated racing specification: Racer Crus. You think the old ones were made with a racing edition?"
Ichijou"...Haan. Point."

香奈枝「あら。 　一条さんはサーキットは初めて？」

一条「……そりゃそうか」

That is the position. For armor racing, mass production defeats the masterpiece.

No rule forbids masterpieces from entering. Occasionally some enthusiast brings one. Good results, however, nobody has brought back.

They are such a small minority that entering unnoticed is impossible. Silver Star, bright silver-white also, would hardly disappear among the racers.

...Although, on performance alone, Silver Star would probably qualify quite comfortably. Even this rule it could likely embarrass.

Some other method must be found—
en.text:
Now that the plan is settled, I would like to go into the pits and check every tsurugi not on the course. A very good wish. No entry for outsiders, however.

The police name has no purchasing power here. Show the rising-sun emblem, and a guard might not even spend a nod on it.

This Yamato Grand Prix, the first unified national championship since the war, is organized by Rokuhara. Under their roof, we cannot simply insist our way in.

Some other method must be found—

ja.html:
方針が定まった以上、今すぐにでもピットを覗いて
コースに出ていない騎体を調べて回りたいところだが、
それは無理な話だ。
　関係者以外は立ち入り禁止と決まっている。

　警察の名もここでは通用しない。
　警備員は旭の紋章など見ても会釈さえするかどうか。

　この大和ＧＰ、戦後初の国内統一選手権の主催者は
<ruby>六波羅<rt>・・・</rt></ruby>なのだ。
　彼らの息が掛かった場所で無理を通せる筈もない。

　何か手立てを考えなくてはならないが――

en.html:
Ichijou"Anyway, what's happening now?"
Kanae"Pre-qualifying. Riders without much of a record—second-rate, to put it plainly—are going through the sieve."
Sayo"Today's better performers fly in the main qualifying tomorrow, alongside the seeded riders."
Ichijou"How do they decide who's better? Everyone's flying, resting, apni marzi, whatever they feel like."
Kanae"Lap times. The whole 'on your marks, ready, go' business, everyone starting together—that is for the final race."
Ichijou"Ohh..."

en.html:
Sayo"For pre-qualifying, some of these riders are doing rather well. That one just out of the hairpin, especially. Quite something."
Kageaki"Yokomori Forge's Hound... Yokotan Works should be a seeded entry. Perhaps a semi-works team?"
Kanae"Rather bold modifications for that, na? The suspension is transplanted from something else entirely. Some wealthy seth's private team, perhaps?"
Ichijou"...Arre, overtaken! Did you see that? Showed right, then shoved through from the left? Full sparks!"
Sayo"Oh, the police team, is it not? Finally finding its rhythm, by the look of it."
Kageaki"Tamura's Hot Bolt... Good use of an old machine."
Kanae"With a good rider and mechanic, it can still compete at the front, can't it? Though the weight is a headache..."
Ichijou"Looks strong."
Sayo"Indeed. Acceleration leaves a question mark, but in a crowd of machines knocking into one another, it does very well. If the race turns rough, the advantage is theirs."

en.html:
Attacking another tsurugi is a foul. Ramming into one is permitted. Haan, this distinction is maintained with full seriousness. It is why the relatively heavy armor of the Tamura Hot Bolt still has employment.

But an old machine remains old. Not enough speed down the straight, and the newer models turn far better. Rider and crew can work themselves into a high placing. Winning is another matter.

...While I am thinking this, the Hound it passed on the straight casually takes the place back at the corner.

ja.html:
装甲競技において他騎への攻撃はもちろん反則行為
だが、体当たりは許容範囲とされている。
　重装甲（比較的、だが）のタムラ・ホットボルトが
旧式でありながら未だ生き残っていられる所以だ。

　とはいえ所詮、過去の騎体。
　直線の伸びを欠く上、旋回性能でも最新騎に大きく
劣るときては、騎手はじめスタッフ陣の奮闘で上位へ
食い込めはしても勝つまでには至らない。

　……などと考えているそばから、ストレートで一度
は抜いたハウンドにコーナーであっさり抜き返されて
いる。

Warriors also. But their tsurugi are nothing like the machines on the track. Heavier, more rugged.

Military-standard dragoons. Guards for the VIP enclosure, probably. Against terrorists, and against the accidents which racing brings along with it.

Truly.

To escape the looks around us, I turn toward the clock tower. Pre-qualifying is nearly over.

What now? An ordinary spectator's investigation can go only so far, and that 'far' is hardly anywhere. To investigate properly, we need freedom to move inside the venue.

Who has it? Officials first. Sponsors next, then the participating teams, I suppose. We should find our way into one of those groups.

Achha. In that case, the move is—

　さて。
　そうなると、手は――――

en.html:
Kanae"...Sayo."
Sayo"Ji."
Kanae"Look there."
Sayo"The VIP enclosure?"
Kanae"Far right. The Princess of Horigoe is here."
Sayo"Arre! Chachamaru? Now there is a face from the old days..."
Kanae"No introduction at the earlier ceremony. Incognito, I suppose."
Sayo"The rumors promise someone unconventional. At least that promise is being kept."
Kanae"Beside her... who is that lady?"
Sayo"Probably Lady Yuutsuzu. A court attendant Chachamaru favors exceptionally. Some say the attendant position is only a cover, and she is actually Chachamaru's mother—Chachamaru being said to come from low birth."
Kanae"...Her mother. Then, if that is true, she is Emishi—ah. Forbidden topic."
Sayo"An open secret, though. The Lord of Horigoe being half Emishi, a half-dwarf."
Kanae"Still, a little inconvenient. Should I make sure we do not meet?"
Sayo"Hardly necessary, madam. You met her only a few times when she was very small, if I recall."
Sayo"She is unlikely to remember."
Kanae"True. Then perhaps an accidental meeting need not become an exercise in awkward silence."
Sayo"With her, one does wonder how to behave. Shishiku would be simple enough."
Kanae"The others are difficult to read. Friendly, at any rate, is hardly likely."
Sayo"For now there is no need to deliver a quarrel personally to their doorstep."
Kanae"Yes... Let us not worry too much about it."

ja.html:
香奈枝「……さよ」
さよ「は」
香奈枝「あちらをご覧なさいな」
さよ「貴賓席でございますか？」
香奈枝「その……右端のほう。 　堀越の姫君がいらっしゃいます」
さよ「なんと。茶々丸さまですか!? 　おやまあ、お懐かしい……」
香奈枝「先刻のセレモニーで紹介されていなかった ところからして、お忍びなのでしょうねぇ」
さよ「噂に違わぬ、型破りな御方のようで」
香奈枝「隣に……あれはどなたかしら。 　御婦人がいらっしゃるけど」
さよ「おそらく長庚局ゆうつづのつぼねなる方でございましょう。 茶々丸さまの寵愛並々ならぬ女官とか。 　女官とは仮の姿、あれは卑賤の出とされる 茶々丸さまの母なのだと云う者もおりますね」
香奈枝「……母親。 　もしそうなら、あれは蝦夷の方――とっ、 これは禁句でしたね」
さよ「ま、公然の秘密というものでございますが。 　堀越公方殿が半蝦夷ハーフドワーフであることは」
香奈枝「それにしても、少しばかり不都合ですね。 　顔を会わせないように気をつけた方がいい のかしら？」
さよ「それは、さほど気にせずとも平気でござい ましょう。お嬢さまとかの姫君は、あちらが ご幼少のみぎりにほんの数度お会いしたきり のはず」
さよ「ご記憶ではございますまい」
香奈枝「そうね。 　ならばったり出会って気まずい空気に…… なんてことにもならなくて済むかしら」
さよ「あの御方とはどう接したものか、いささか 迷ってしまいますからねぇ。 　獅子吼殿なら話は簡単なのですが」
香奈枝「他の方々・・・・は出方が読めません。 　友好的ということはまず無いでしょうけど」
さよ「差し当たって、こちらからわざわざ喧嘩を 売りに行く必要はございますまい」
香奈枝「そうね……。 　あまり気にしないことにしておきましょう」
